calamidade_awakening.configuration.vanil: Atmosphere fog through the game fog
Recommended. Terrain, entities, particles, water and clouds are fogged at their real distance. Turn off only if a shader pack ignores the game fog: the mod then draws the fog on the screen.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.custo: Skyboxes (cubemaps, panoramas, gradients), star fields, constellations and nebulae that addons draw behind everything. Off: the vanilla sky stays. Does not turn off the engine’s procedural sky layers (black holes, eclipses...).

command.calamidade_awakening.status.terr: Terrain: %s writing · %s undoable · %s commits · %s blocks written · refused %s (config %s, dimension %s, mobGriefing %s, event %s, volume %s, structure %s, error %s, explosion event %s, permission %s, protected %s)
calamidade_awakening.configuration.terra: Terrain (Terrain API)
Craters, burnt shells and blocks placed by effects. Conservative defaults.
Terrain edits
Turns every terrain edit of the effects on or off.
Largest volume per edit
Most planned blocks in one edit (carved, shell, fill, structure). Larger edits are refused.
Blocks per tick
Blocks written per server tick, shared by the running edits. An edit may ask for less.
Allowed dimensions
Dimensions where edits run ("*" for all).
Allow replacing blocks with a block entity
Edits that explicitly ask for it may replace chests, furnaces and blocks of other mods (their contents go to the undo snapshot).
Respect mobGriefing
Edits started by a mob follow the mobGriefing game rule.
Minutes to undo
How long an edit can be undone with /calamidade terrain undo (0 keeps no snapshot).
Snapshots kept
Most undo snapshots kept (the oldest go first).
Largest structure
Largest .nbt structure an edit may place, blocks per axis.
Go through the explosion event

Every edit also goes through NeoForge's explosion events: protection mods (claims, regions) that protect against explosions protect against craters. Off: only TerrainEditEvent, world border and spawn protection.
Respect spawn protection
Edits leave the spawn protection area (spawn-protection in server.properties) intact; an operator is exempt only when the edit is theirs.

calamidade_awakening.configuration.quali: Profile in use and per-frame caps of each profile. Values have safety maxima.

calamidade_awakening.configuration.ultra: Caps of the ULTRA profile, for strong machines.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.drawn: Effects drawn per frame (HERO included). The others keep running, they are just not drawn that frame. At most 64.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.passe: Full-screen passes per frame for common effects (card shaders, post passes, beams and lights). At most 16.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.heroP: Passes per frame reserved for protagonist (HERO) effects. At most 8.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.heroe: Protagonists drawn per frame, the nearest ones. Never above the effects drawn. At most 4.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.beams: Beams drawn per frame. At most 128.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.light: Visual lights drawn per frame. At most 64.
perf.calamidade_awakening.quality.start: Quality: AUTO → %s · started %s s ago · target %s ms
perf.calamidade_awakening.quality.down: Quality: AUTO → %s · down from %s %s s ago (p95 %s ms > %s ms)
perf.calamidade_awakening.quality.up: Quality: AUTO → %s · up from %s %s s ago (p95 %s ms < %s ms, effects cut)
AUTO (default) switches profiles by the p95 frame time, with hysteresis and never during a HERO effect. LOW, BALANCED, HIGH or ULTRA force a profile. F8 cycles it.
calamidade_awakening.configuration.autoT: AUTO goes down when the p95 frame time stays 20% above 1000/FPS with effects on screen, and up when it stays 30% below while the caps cut effects. With VSync or a frame cap at this value, AUTO only goes down.
